_notes.about: Lesson 16 in English (en and en-GB, which has its own keyboard). From the lesson plan "Typing Game Sentence Bank: Lessons 2-13". The id is the lesson's scoreboard: never change it.
_notes.intro: Page 1, before the keys: anything that doesn't fit on Page 2 (lesson 1: "what is touch typing?"). Leave it out and the lesson starts at the new keys. "title" and "paragraphs"; in a paragraph, **bold** and [E] (a key drawn as a key: [space], [;], [Tab] ...). "picture": "hands" (the default: the hands over the lesson's keyboard), "none", or a picture file in images/ (with "pictureAlt", what it shows). With "hands": "reach" sends fingers to keys ({"lm": "e", "rm": "i"}: lp lr lm li, rp rr rm ri; keys "e", ";", "ShiftL", "ShiftR" ...; the others stay home), and "keys" says which keys show: "letters" (the default), "shift", "symbols" or "all".
_notes.hideHand: "left", "right" or "none": that hand isn't drawn on Page 2, and its column of new keys isn't listed.
_notes.sentenceLists: Up to four lists: name (shown above the typing box, or ""), count (how many to pick at random each attempt; 0 = unused) and sentences. Use real words, and only keys taught so far. Lesson 1 has no end mark because ";" hasn't been taught. Write ⇥ for the Tab key and ↵ for Enter.

title: Lesson 16: Numbers 6 to 0

intro.title: The number row: 6 to 0
paragraphs: The right hand types [6] to [0]: the index finger both [6] and [7], the middle finger [8], the ring finger [9], and the little finger [0].
Like 1 to 5, lift your hand a little, reach up two rows, and come straight back to the home row.

reaches.caption: [7] [8] [9] [0]: each finger straight up from its home key
[6]: the right index finger, up and in

advice: [7] is above [U], and [6] above [Y]: both are for your right index finger.
[8] is above [I] (middle finger), [9] above [O] (ring finger), and [0] above [P] (little finger).
Numbers with more than one digit often use both hands: 1961 is left, right, right, left.

sentences: There are 7 days in a week.
A year has 12 months and 365 days.
Bo is about 250 kilometers from Freetown.
The school bell rings at 8 every morning.
Mohamed scored 98 on his math test.
The bus left at 9 and arrived at 10.
There are 60 minutes in an hour.
Room 906 is at the end of the hall.
The shop sold 70 bottles of water.
Isatu read 9 books during the holidays.
It rained for 6 days in a row.
There are 26 letters in the alphabet.
The exam starts at 9 and ends at 12.
